tips_en: Read paper 3 first: it offers the clearest practical insight into long-horizon agents, showing that hindsight context plus progress-based judging can substantially improve credit assignment and even let a smaller policy outperform a larger outcome-only baseline. It connects to paper 2 through its emphasis on model reliability and to paper 1 through the shared use of feedback, verification, and iterative refinement, albeit in agent teaching rather than physical video generation.
tips_zh: 建议先读第三篇：它清晰展示了长时程智能体中的关键经验，即结合后见上下文与进度式判断可以显著改善信用分配，甚至让较小策略超过更大的纯结果学习基线。它与第二篇都关注模型可靠性，也和第一篇共享反馈、验证与迭代修正的思路，只是前者关注智能体教学，后者关注物理一致性视频生成。
